title: Mollification estimate for a set with bounded perimeter
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, F ⊆ ℝⁿ Borel, R, C, ε ∈ ℝ with ε ≤ 1, and let ρ : ℝⁿ → ℝ be continuous with compact support, ρ ≥ 0, ∫ ρ dL = 1 and support ρ ⊆ B_ε(0). Assume ∫_F div g dL ≤ C for every C¹ vector field g with compact support, tsupport g ⊆ B_{R+1}(0) and |g| ≤ 1. Then ∫_{B_R(0)} |1_F(z) − ∫ ρ(y) 1_F(z − y) dy| dz ≤ ε·C.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Set (Euclid n)) (R C ε : ℝ) (ρ : Euclid n → ℝ), MeasurableSet F → ε ≤ 1 → Continuous ρ → HasCompactSupport ρ → (∀ y, 0 ≤ ρ y) → ∫ y, ρ y = 1 → support ρ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) ε → (∀ g : Euclid n → Euclid n, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) (R + 1) → (∀ z, ‖g z‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ z in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid n) (fderiv ℝ g z : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid n) ≤ C) → ∫ z in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, |F.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z - ∫ y, ρ y * F.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (z - y)| ≤ ε * C
